solutionSql:
WITH scanned AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id
  FROM staging_scans
  WHERE id IS NOT NULL AND status IS NOT NULL
),
islands AS (
  SELECT id, id - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) AS island
  FROM scanned
)
SELECT MIN(id) AS start_id,
       MAX(id) AS end_id,
       COUNT(*) AS scans
FROM islands
GROUP BY island
ORDER BY start_id;
ambiguities: NULL scan ids are not ids, so they are excluded from the islands. The ticket does not say how to treat them.

An id sent twice with one copy carrying a status and one copy NULL: I counted it as carrying a status (WHERE status IS NOT NULL before DISTINCT). Another reading would require every copy to carry a status.
'Consecutive' is read as the id rising by exactly 1, so a missing id breaks an island. The ticket implies this but does not state it.
The count column is bigint, and the ticket names no types.
notes: Sample islands checked by hand: 1000-1004 (5), 1006-1007 (2, duplicate 1007 counted once), 1009-1015 (7), 1017-1026 (10), 1028-1037 (10), 1039 (1). All three named datasets returned identical output, so I cannot say from my runs whether hidden rows hold NULL ids or conflicting duplicates.
